description:
Import an existing Lightning wallet into the embedded Spark-backed store from a BIP39 mnemonic phrase. Encrypted locally at ~/.aibtc/lightning/keystore.json.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

mnemonic.description: BIP39 mnemonic phrase - WARNING: sensitive value

password.description: Password to protect the Lightning wallet (minimum 8 characters) - WARNING: sensitive value

name: lightning_import
